label: Chongos zamoranos
note: Milk is set with rennet and served on a sweet brown milky syrup; origin attributed to colonial convents of Zamora, Michoacán

about.text: Chongos zamoranos is a Mexican dessert of curdled milk, made with rennet tablets, milk, sugar and cinnamon. The result is soft cheese-like curd in a sweet brown milky syrup; its origin is attributed to convents in Zamora, Michoacán, in the colonial period.
